# Google AI Tools (googleaitools.com) - Full Dataset (llms-full.txt)

> Google AI Tools is an independent publication covering artificial intelligence tools, models, and platforms — with specialized coverage of Google Gemini, NotebookLM, Google AI Studio, Vertex AI, Imagen, Veo, Gemma, and the broader AI ecosystem.

---

## ABOUT US
URL: https://googleaitools.com/about/

Non-Affiliation Notice: GoogleAITools.com is an independent blog. We are not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or officially connected to Google LLC or Alphabet Inc. in any way.

Our Mission: GoogleAITools.com is an independent publication covering artificial intelligence tools, models, and platforms — with a particular focus on developments from Google, including Gemini, NotebookLM, Google AI Studio, Vertex AI, and other tools across Google's AI ecosystem, alongside broader coverage of the AI tools landscape.

We started this site because AI is moving fast — new models, features, and tools are released constantly, and it's hard to keep up. Our goal is to make that easier: clear write-ups, comparisons, and practical guides on the AI tools that matter, written for people who want to actually use these tools.

## ARTICLE: Getting Started with Gemini 1.5 Pro: The 2 Million Token Context Revolution
URL: https://googleaitools.com/getting-started-with-gemini-1-5-pro/
Category: Multimodal AI

Google's Gemini 1.5 Pro introduces a breakthrough 2 million token context window, allowing developers and researchers to process entire codebases, multi-hour video streams, extensive financial documentation, and full-length audio recordings in a single prompt. Key capabilities include multimodal understanding, native audio/video tokenization, and rapid Needle-in-a-Haystack retrieval across massive datasets.

---

## ARTICLE: How to Use Gemini 1.5 Flash: Ultra-Fast Multimodal Workflows
URL: https://googleaitools.com/how-to-use-gemini-15-flash/
Category: Multimodal AI

Gemini 1.5 Flash is optimized for high-volume, low-latency tasks where speed and cost-efficiency are critical. Featuring a 1 million token context window, Gemini 1.5 Flash excels at high-speed document summarization, real-time visual inspection, audio transcription processing, and high-throughput customer support agent pipelines.

---

## ARTICLE: NotebookLM Ultimate Guide: Transform Notes & PDFs into Audio Overviews
URL: https://googleaitools.com/notebooklm-ai-research-guide/
Category: Research & Productivity

NotebookLM leverages Gemini 1.5 Pro to turn your personal documents, PDFs, Google Docs, and web links into an interactive research assistant. Its signature feature, Audio Overviews, generates realistic two-host conversational podcasts discussing your uploaded sources, providing grounded summaries without hallucinating external information.

---

## ARTICLE: Imagen 3 Prompt Engineering Masterclass: Photorealistic AI Image Generation
URL: https://googleaitools.com/imagen-3-prompt-engineering-tips/
Category: Image & Video AI

Google's Imagen 3 delivers state-of-the-art text-to-image synthesis with enhanced detail, lighting, text rendering, and artifact reduction. Prompting best practices include specifying lighting styles (cinematic key light, volumetric rays), camera framing (35mm lens, f/1.8 aperture), and avoiding prompt clutter.

---

## ARTICLE: Google Veo Deep Dive: High-Definition 1080p AI Video Generation
URL: https://googleaitools.com/google-veo-video-generation-tutorial/
Category: Image & Video AI

Google Veo generates 1080p high-definition video clips extending over 60 seconds from natural text and image prompts. It understands film terminology (timelapse, aerial drone shots, pan/tilt) and maintains consistent temporal consistency across frames for visual storytelling.

---

## ARTICLE: Gemma 2 Open Models: Fine-Tuning Lightweight AI on Local Hardware
URL: https://googleaitools.com/gemma-open-source-ai-models-guide/
Category: Open Source Models

Gemma 2 is Google's state-of-the-art family of lightweight open weights models available in 2B, 9B, and 27B parameter sizes. Designed for local execution, Ollama integration, and fine-tuning on consumer GPUs, Gemma 2 matches or exceeds larger open models while running efficiently on workstation hardware.
